t: The Matter Beamer sends material items to a $(l:rftoolsbase:machines/spawner)Spawner$(/l). It has one input slot, uses FE while active, and beams items only when the linked spawner can use them.
物质投影仪可将物品材料传送至$(l:rftoolsbase:machines/spawner)生物生成器$(/l)。它拥有一个输入槽位，运行时消耗FE，且仅当链接的生物生成器能够使用这些物品时才进行投射。
Use a wrench on the Matter Beamer, then use the wrench on the target Spawner. Wrenching the selected beamer again clears the destination.
使用扳手右键点击物质投影仪，再用同一把扳手右键点击目标生物生成器。再次对已选定的投影仪使用扳手，即可清除其目的地设定。
Give the beamer a redstone signal and insert materials needed by the spawner recipe. $(5)Infusing$() sends more items per pulse and reduces FE cost.
向物质投影仪输入红石信号，并插入生成器配方所需的材料。$(5)注魔$()可提升每次脉冲输出的物品数量，并降低FE消耗。
